name: Supported Payment Option 2 Code
definition: Specifies the options supported for a payment transaction.

PART.name: Partial Approval
PART.definition: The entity supports a partial approval of the payment transaction.

MSRV.name: Payment Approval Only
MSRV.definition: The entity supports the approval of the payment service along with the decline of additional requested services (as cash-back).

INSI.name: Issuer Instalment
INSI.definition: The sender support IssuerInstalment proposals to the Cardholder.

PINQ.name: PIN Request
PINQ.definition: The sender is able to support Single Tap transaction.
